name: wall-finance
description: WALL Finance v1.0 — finanças pessoais (módulo do WALL OS) em Cloudflare Pages + D1

scripts.dev: node scripts/vendor-ocr.mjs && wrangler pages dev public --port 8788
scripts.test:e2e: node scripts/vendor-ocr.mjs && node tests/e2e/migration.mjs && node tests/e2e/run.mjs
scripts.deploy: node scripts/vendor-ocr.mjs && wrangler pages deploy public --project-name wall-finance --branch main
